hook.en: Spin a tube of blood in a centrifuge and it splits into two layers: a straw-coloured liquid on top and a red layer below. What are these two parts made of?
hook.kn: ರಕ್ತದ ನಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸೆಂಟ್ರಿಫ್ಯೂಜ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಎರಡು ಪದರಗಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ: ಮೇಲೆ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಬಣ್ಣದ ದ್ರವ, ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕೆಂಪು ಪದರ. ಇವು ಯಾವುದರಿಂದ ಆಗಿವೆ?

objectives.en: List the components of plasma and their roles
Give the counts and functions of RBCs, WBCs and platelets

narration.en: Spin a tube of blood in a centrifuge and it splits into two layers: a straw-coloured liquid on top and a red layer below. What are these two parts made of?
narration.kn: ರಕ್ತದ ನಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸೆಂಟ್ರಿಫ್ಯೂಜ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಎರಡು ಪದರಗಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ: ಮೇಲೆ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಬಣ್ಣದ ದ್ರವ, ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕೆಂಪು ಪದರ. ಇವು ಯಾವುದರಿಂದ ಆಗಿವೆ?

body.en: Blood is a special connective tissue made of a fluid matrix, plasma, and formed elements. Plasma is a straw-coloured, viscous fluid forming nearly 55 per cent of blood. It is 90–92 per cent water, and proteins make up 6–8 per cent. Fibrinogen is needed for clotting, globulins for defence and albumins for osmotic balance. Plasma also carries minerals such as Na+, Ca++, Mg++, HCO3− and Cl−, and glucose, amino acids and lipids in transit. Plasma without the clotting factors is called serum.
body.kn: ರಕ್ತ ಒಂದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ. ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾ ರಕ್ತದ ಸುಮಾರು 55% ಇದ್ದು, 90–92% ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು 6–8% ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಫೈಬ್ರಿನೋಜೆನ್ ಹೆಪ್ಪುಗಟ್ಟಲು, ಗ್ಲಾಬ್ಯುಲಿನ್ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ, ಆಲ್ಬುಮಿನ್ ಆಸ್ಮೋಟಿಕ್ ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ. ಹೆಪ್ಪುಗಟ್ಟುವ ಅಂಶಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾವೇ ಸೀರಮ್.

narration.en: Blood is a special connective tissue made of a fluid matrix, plasma, and formed elements. Plasma is a straw-coloured, viscous fluid forming nearly 55 per cent of blood. It is 90–92 per cent water, and proteins make up 6–8 per cent. Fibrinogen is needed for clotting, globulins for defence and albumins for osmotic balance. Plasma also carries minerals such as Na+, Ca++, Mg++, HCO3− and Cl−, and glucose, amino acids and lipids in transit. Plasma without the clotting factors is called serum.
narration.kn: ರಕ್ತ ಒಂದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ. ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾ ರಕ್ತದ ಸುಮಾರು 55% ಇದ್ದು, 90–92% ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು 6–8% ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಫೈಬ್ರಿನೋಜೆನ್ ಹೆಪ್ಪುಗಟ್ಟಲು, ಗ್ಲಾಬ್ಯುಲಿನ್ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ, ಆಲ್ಬುಮಿನ್ ಆಸ್ಮೋಟಿಕ್ ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ. ಹೆಪ್ಪುಗಟ್ಟುವ ಅಂಶಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾವೇ ಸೀರಮ್.

body.en: Erythrocytes (RBCs) are the most abundant cells: 5 to 5.5 million per mm³. In adults they form in the red bone marrow, have no nucleus in most mammals, are biconcave and contain haemoglobin (12–16 g per 100 mL of blood). They live about 120 days and are destroyed in the spleen, the graveyard of RBCs. Leucocytes (WBCs) are nucleated, colourless and number 6000–8000 per mm³. Platelets (thrombocytes) are cell fragments from megakaryocytes, 1,50,000–3,50,000 per mm³, and release factors for clotting.
body.kn: ಕೆಂಪು ರಕ್ತಕಣಗಳು ಪ್ರತಿ ಘನ ಮಿ.ಮೀ.ಗೆ 50–55 ಲಕ್ಷ; ಕೆಂಪು ಮೂಳೆ ಮಜ್ಜೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ, ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರವಿಲ್ಲ, 120 ದಿನ ಬದುಕುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗುಲ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಿಳಿ ರಕ್ತಕಣಗಳು 6000–8000. ಕಿರುತಟ್ಟೆಗಳು ಮೆಗಾಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳ ತುಣುಕುಗಳು.

narration.en: Erythrocytes (RBCs) are the most abundant cells: 5 to 5.5 million per mm³. In adults they form in the red bone marrow, have no nucleus in most mammals, are biconcave and contain haemoglobin (12–16 g per 100 mL of blood). They live about 120 days and are destroyed in the spleen, the graveyard of RBCs. Leucocytes (WBCs) are nucleated, colourless and number 6000–8000 per mm³. body.en: Granulocytes are neutrophils, eosinophils and basophils; agranulocytes are lymphocytes and monocytes. Neutrophils are the most abundant WBCs (60–65 per cent) and basophils the least (0.5–1 per cent). Neutrophils and monocytes (6–8 per cent) are phagocytic. Basophils secrete histamine, serotonin and heparin and take part in inflammation. Eosinophils (2–3 per cent) resist infections and are associated with allergic reactions. Lymphocytes (20–25 per cent) are of two types, B and T, and are responsible for immune responses.
body.kn: ಗ್ರ್ಯಾನ್ಯುಲೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು: ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರೋಫಿಲ್, ಇಯೋಸಿನೋಫಿಲ್, ಬೇಸೋಫಿಲ್. ಅಗ್ರ್ಯಾನ್ಯುಲೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು: ಲಿಂಫೋಸೈಟ್, ಮೋನೋಸೈಟ್. ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರೋಫಿಲ್‌ಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಬೇಸೋಫಿಲ್‌ಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಬಿ ಮತ್ತು ಟಿ ಲಿಂಫೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ರೋಗನಿರೋಧಕ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣ.

problem.en: A blood report shows a total WBC count of 8000 per mm³ with 62% neutrophils and 25% lymphocytes. How many neutrophils and lymphocytes are present per mm³, and are these within the NCERT ranges?

steps.en: NCERT ranges: neutrophils 60–65%, lymphocytes 20–25%; total WBC 6000–8000 per mm³. All values are normal.

answer.en: 4960 neutrophils and 2000 lymphocytes per mm³ — both within normal ranges

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A blood report shows a total WBC count of 8000 per mm³ with 62% neutrophils and 25% lymphocytes. How many neutrophils and lymphocytes are present per mm³, and are these within the NCERT ranges?
WBCs from most to least. Neutrophils > Lymphocytes > Monocytes > Eosinophils > Basophils.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.
